summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for Secure & Tamper-Evident Governance Records in BrandPulse Sentinel AI. Covers session-based authentication with RBAC (Admin, Curator, Reviewer, Author), SQLite durable storage with WAL mode and transaction safeguards, tamper-evident SHA-256 hash-chained audit logging with periodic checkpoints, Ed25519 asymmetric Trust Passport digital signatures with key ID rotation and legacy unsigned passport handling, minimal security UI extensions, and test suites.
